title: Deploying Client Connector on ChromeOS and ChromeOS Flex through the Google Admin console

prose.label: Force install and Always on VPN.
Install parameters.
prose.text: {{workspace-managed-config}} The parameter behavior itself is in [[zcc.install.enrollment:android-auto-enroll]].

prose.label: Certificates.
prose.text: The ChromeOS Flex certificate steps are in [[zcc.ssl-inspection.certificate-install:chromeos-flex]]; the general certificate deployment is in [[zcc.ssl-inspection.certificate-install]].

prose.label: Open points.
prose.text: Requirements for ChromeOS devices other than Flex, and whether ArcVM preloading is needed outside Flex, are open {{gap:non-flex-requirements}}.

flex-support.statement: Zscaler supports ChromeOS Flex for managed devices through ChromeOS Device Management, which is accessible through the Google Admin console.

quotes: Zscaler supports ChromeOS Flex for managed devices through ChromeOS Device Management, which is accessible through the Google Admin console.

flex-hardware.statement: To run Client Connector with ChromeOS Flex, a device needs 16 GB of RAM, a 32 GB or larger solid-state storage device, an AMD-based device from 2019 or later or an Intel-based device from 2017 (Kaby Lake +) or later (excluding Ice Lake), and hardware virtualization enabled in the BIOS.

quotes: Devices must meet the following hardware requirements to run Zscaler Client Connector with ChromeOS Flex:
16 GB of RAM
32 GB or larger solid-state storage device
AMD-based device from 2019 or later
Intel-based device from 2017 (Kaby Lake +) or later (excluding Ice Lake)
Hardware virtualization enabled in the device BIOS

flex-prerequisites.statement: The ChromeOS Flex guide's prerequisites are that ChromeOS Flex is installed on the device, the device is enrolled in the Google Admin console, and the device is updated to the minimum ChromeOS Flex version 135.

quotes: ChromeOS Flex is installed on the device.
The device is enrolled in the Google Admin console.
The device is updated to the minimum ChromeOS Flex version 135.

flex-arcvm.statement: Android Runtime for Chrome controls preloading a VM (ArcVM) image to devices running ChromeOS Flex, ArcVM being the current method for booting Android under ChromeOS; selecting Enable ArcVM image preloading is required to deploy and run Client Connector on ChromeOS Flex.

quotes: Android Runtime for Chrome controls preloading a VM (ArcVM) image to devices running ChromeOS Flex.
ArcVM is the current method for booting Android under ChromeOS.
Selecting the Enable ArcVM image preloading option allows an ArcVM image to preload separately on ChromeOS Flex. This is required to deploy and run Zscaler Client Connector on ChromeOS Flex.

force-install.statement: ChromeOS Flex requires a force install of Client Connector for users in the organization, with Installation policy Force install + pin to ChromeOS taskbar or Force install; the Google Workspace guide selects the Client Connector - Chromebook app from the Google Play Store and Force install to install the application at the endpoint.

quotes: ChromeOS Flex for Zscaler Client Connector requires a force install for users in your organization.
Under Installation policy, select Force install + pin to ChromeOS taskbar or Force install.
From the Google Play Store, select the Client Connector - Chromebook app for Chrome devices.
under the Installation policy drop-down menu, select Force install to install the application at the endpoint

always-on-vpn.statement: On ChromeOS Flex, Client Connector uses the ChromeOS Flex Android VPN app to establish and maintain a secure connection to the internet and the Zscaler cloud, and Client Connector - Chromebook is selected in the Select an Always on VPN app window. The page says only apps with the Installation Policy Force install appear in the search when selecting the app, and users might be required to restart Chromebooks for the changes to be applied.

quotes: Zscaler Client Connector uses the ChromeOS Flex Android VPN app to establish and maintain a secure connection to the internet and to the Zscaler secure cloud platform.
In the Select an Always on VPN app window, select Client Connector - Chromebook and click OK.
Apps with the Installation Policy configured as Force install appear in the search. Apps with any other configurations do not appear here.
Users might be required to restart Chromebooks for the changes to be applied.

workspace-managed-config.statement: Google Workspace deployment needs a required license for managing ChromeOS devices before deployment, and the app's Managed configuration takes parameters as JSON; the vendor's example has userDomain, cloudName zscalerone, autoEnrollWithMDM "1", deviceToken and externalDeviceId ${DEVICE_SERIAL_NUMBER}.

quotes: You must have a required license for managing ChromeOS devices before deployment.
Under Managed configuration, enter the following JSON format:
{ "userDomain":"<org’s_domain>", "cloudName":"zscalerone", "autoEnrollWithMDM":"1", "deviceToken":"<token_value>", "externalDeviceId":"${DEVICE_SERIAL_NUMBER}" }

non-flex-requirements.title: Requirements for ChromeOS devices other than Flex, and ArcVM outside Flex
non-flex-requirements.detail: The captured guides give hardware, version and ArcVM requirements for ChromeOS Flex only; the Google Workspace guide gives a license, force install and Always on VPN steps. Whether other ChromeOS devices need the same hardware and version floor, or ArcVM image preloading, is not stated.
